title: Toeplitz-like logical experts and heads
hypothesis: A shared circular-convolution kernel plus per-task shift/gain codes recovers structured logical maps at low actual payload bytes when tasks align, while private kernel variation reveals where task-private parameters become necessary.
mirror_coordinate: per-task integer cyclic shift and scalar gain
controls: independent Toeplitz kernel fit (private kernel upper control)
native shared circular-convolution shift/gain coordinates with canonical byte-identical encoding

development.selection_metric: held-out normalized MSE, actual serialized bytes, and analytic operations proxy across frozen private-variation levels

success_gate: At least one private-variation level across all audit seeds: held-out NRMSE <=1e-5, full candidate payload <=25% independent dense payload, inference arithmetic <=1.25x Toeplitz FFT proxy, and strict improvement over byte-near native shared circular-convolution coordinates. Exact native alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific attribution.
failure_gate: Exact native circular-convolution coordinate alias, or no private-variation level meets quality/byte/compute gates. Record aligned storage frontier and private residual break-even without treating logical combinations as independent capacity.
boundaries: Synthetic linear input-output tasks generated from circular-convolution kernels; no trained network, natural task or language quality claim.
The shared teacher kernel is known by construction; this is a representation upper-bound screen, not a learning-efficiency result.
DCT-diagonal is a compact structured control, not a full ACDC implementation.
No GPU/fused/production latency claim; operation counts are analytic proxies.
Private state is represented by the independent Toeplitz upper control; no residual-rank sweep is included in this screen.
